description: This file contains implementation of functions related to processing Signed Certificate Timestamps (SCTs), including serialization to dictionaries for logging purposes, and encoding binary data in base64.

methods.name: SetBinaryData
methods.description: Encodes a string value in base64 and sets it in a dictionary with the specified key.

methods.name: SCTToDictionary
methods.description: Converts a SignedCertificateTimestamp object and its verification status into a dictionary for logging.

methods.name: SCTListToPrintableValues
methods.description: Converts a list of SCTs and their statuses into a list of dictionaries for logging.

methods.name: NetLogSignedCertificateTimestampParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary containing a list of SCTs for logging.

methods.name: NetLogRawSignedCertificateTimestampParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with raw SCT data encoded in base64 for logging.
